extracted.intended_audience: trademark examiners, intellectual property professionals, and designers classifying figurative elements of marks
extracted.subtask_description: A section of the Vienna Classification (5th Edition) listing categories, divisions and principal/auxiliary sections used to classify figurative elements (pictorial components) of trademarks. It enumerates product/subject-matter groupings and explanatory notes for correct classification.

rubrics_metrics.name: 8.5 Butchers’ meat, pork products, fishmongers’ products (8.5.1)
rubrics_metrics.description: Butchers’ meat, pork products, fishmongers’ products (principal section 8.5.1).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Auxiliary sections associated with 8.5.1 include A 8.5.2, A 8.5.3, A 8.5.4, A 8.5.10, A 8.5.15, A 8.5.25 (Other butchers’ meat, other pork products). Examples listed: ham, legs of mutton, joints of meat; fresh/dry sausages and salami; sliced meat/pork products; poultry or game cooked/prepared for cooking; fish, fillets or fishmongers' products cooked/prepared for cooking.

rubrics_metrics.name: 8.7 Other foodstuffs (division 8.7)
rubrics_metrics.description: Other foodstuffs and prepared dishes (division 8.7).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Principal items include soups or beverages (8.7.1), macaroni/pasta (8.7.3), pizzas (8.7.4), filled dishes/plates (8.7.5), vegetable dishes and salads (8.7.7), crisps/potato products (8.7.8), eggs and cooked eggs, fruit salads/compotes, baked custard/puddings/omelettes, mixtures of foodstuffs classified in different divisions (8.7.17), and foodstuffs for animals (8.7.21). Also 8.7.25 Other foodstuffs not classified in 8.7.1–8.7.22.

rubrics_metrics.name: 9 Textiles, clothing, sewing accessories, headwear, footwear (division 9)
rubrics_metrics.description: Top-level heading for textile- and clothing-related categories (division 9).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Subdivided into textiles other than clothing (9.1), clothing (9.3), sewing accessories/patterns (9.5), headwear (9.7), and footwear (9.9).

rubrics_metrics.name: 9.1 Textiles other than clothing; shuttles (9.1.1 and related)
rubrics_metrics.description: Textiles and related articles (principal 9.1.1); includes thread, laces, braids, tapes, cords, ropes, stitches, embroidery, trimmings, ribbons, cloth, curtains, carpets, bed coverings, cushions, eiderdowns, cloth labels (9.1.23–9.1.25 for other textile articles).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Notes exclude fishing nets (21.3.16) and bolsters (classified in 12.1.1). Auxiliary sections for different presentations of thread (A 9.1.2–A 9.1.6) and cloth edge/flat linen/samples/fringes (A 9.1.15–A 9.1.22) are provided.

rubrics_metrics.name: 9.3 Clothing (principal sections 9.3.1, 9.3.26)
rubrics_metrics.description: Clothing including jackets, waistcoats, coats, trousers, suits, dresses, aprons, pullovers, shirts, collars, ties, scarves, underwear, gloves, stockings, belts, pockets and parts of clothing (division 9.3).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Note excludes headwear (9.7) and footwear (9.9). Auxiliary sections list many garment types (A 9.3.2–A 9.3.25) and specific exclusions (e.g., boxing gloves reference 21.3.23).

rubrics_metrics.name: 9.5 Sewing accessories, patterns for dressmaking (9.5.1)
rubrics_metrics.description: Sewing needles, thimbles, hooks, pins and other sewing accessories (principal 9.5.1).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See also cross-references (14.3.1) and notes excluding scissors (14.7.18) and tape measures (17.5.1). Auxiliary sections enumerate types of needles, thimbles, crochet hooks, fastening hooks, safety pins (A 9.5.2–A 9.5.9) and buttons, press studs, slide fasteners, patterns (A 9.5.12–A 9.5.16). Patterns resembling clothing are placed in 9.3.

rubrics_metrics.name: 9.7 Headwear (9.7.1)
rubrics_metrics.description: Headwear including turbans, caps, berets, cocked hats, Phrygian caps, fez, broad-brimmed hats, cooks’ caps, protective helmets, kepis, mortarboards and other headwear (division 9.7).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Notes exclude helmets as parts of armour (23.5.5) and certain mythological helmets; auxiliary sections A 9.7.2–A 9.7.25 list specific headwear types.

rubrics_metrics.name: 9.9 Footwear (9.9.1)
rubrics_metrics.description: Footwear including clogs, low/high-heeled shoes, boots, slippers, sports footwear, ski boots, babies' footwear, soles, footprints (division 9.9).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Notes exclude fastening hooks, buttons, press studs, slide fasteners, nails and eyelets (cross-references provided). Auxiliary sections list parts of footwear (A 9.9.2–A 9.9.25).

rubrics_metrics.name: 10 Tobacco, smokers’ requisites, matches; travel goods; toilet articles (division 10)
rubrics_metrics.description: Top-level grouping for tobacco and smokers' requisites (10.1), travel goods/fans/bags (10.3), and toilet articles/mirrors (10.5).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Contains separate principal sections for tobacco (10.1.1), smokers' requisites and matches (10.1.10), travel goods (10.3.1 & 10.3.10), and various toilet articles (10.5.1, 10.5.4 etc.).

rubrics_metrics.name: 10.1 Tobacco; smokers’ requisites, matches (10.1.1, 10.1.10)
rubrics_metrics.description: Tobacco (cut tobacco, cigars, cigarettes, other forms) and smokers' requisites such as pipes, hookahs, holders, cleaners, cutters, jars, pouches, lighters, ash trays, matches (division 10.1).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Note excludes tobacco leaves (5.3.1). Auxiliary sections A 10.1.11–A 10.1.25 list smokers’ requisites; includes not-including notes.

rubrics_metrics.name: 10.3 Travel goods, fans, bags (10.3.1, 10.3.10)
rubrics_metrics.description: Sticks, umbrellas, parasols, fans (10.3.1) and bags, suitcases, trunks (10.3.10) along with shopping bags, satchels, handbags, fasteners, rucksacks and suitcases (auxiliary sections).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Notes exclude slide fasteners (9.5.10); specific auxiliary sections A 10.3.11–A 10.3.16 enumerate bag types.

rubrics_metrics.name: 10.5 Toilet articles, mirrors (10.5.1, 10.5.4)
rubrics_metrics.description: Toothbrushes and toothpaste, shaving articles, hair clippers, combs, lipsticks, mirrors, sprays, soap and other toilet/cosmetic products (division 10.5).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Notes exclude mirrors used in medicine (19.13.1) and sponges/packaging (cross-references). Auxiliary sections list razors, blades, electric razors, shaving brushes (A 10.5.5–A 10.5.9).

rubrics_metrics.name: 11 Household utensils (division 11)
rubrics_metrics.description: Household utensils excluding those in categories 12, 13 or 19; includes knives/forks/spoons/kitchen utensils/machines (11.1), containers/plates/kitchen utensils for serving/cooking (11.3), and other household utensils (11.7).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Principal sections 11.1.1, 11.1.10, 11.3.1, 11.3.5, 11.3.14, 11.3.18 and 11.7.1; auxiliary sections enumerate specific utensils, machines, containers, and serving items (A 11.1.11–A 11.3.25 etc.).

rubrics_metrics.name: 11.1 Knives, forks and spoons; kitchen utensils and machines (11.1.1, 11.1.10)
rubrics_metrics.description: Eating utensils (spoons, forks, knives), sets, chopsticks, spatulas, funnels, strainers, openers, grinders, boards, coffee mills, mixers, rolling pins and other kitchen machines/utensils.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Notes exclude kitchen utensils classified in other divisions (11.3/13.3/19.11). Auxiliary sections A 11.1.2–A 11.1.25 list specific items.

rubrics_metrics.name: 11.3 Containers for beverages, plates and dishes; kitchen utensils for serving/preparing/cooking (11.3.1–11.3.18)
rubrics_metrics.description: Drinking vessels, cups, tea pots, coffee pots, kettles, saucepans, pots, stewpans, frying pans and serving/serving vessels, bowls, sauce boats, cruets and related items.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Auxiliary sections specify glasses, tankards, cups, drinking straws, plates with cutlery, containers with food/drink (A 11.3.2–A 11.3.25).

rubrics_metrics.name: 11.7 Other household utensils (11.7.1)
rubrics_metrics.description: Household utensils not classified in divisions 11.1 or 11.3 — e.g., coat hangers, clothes-pegs/pins, brushes, sponges, steel wool, brooms and window cleaning instruments.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Auxiliary sections A 11.7.3–A 11.7.7 list specific items; notes exclude brushes for toilet purposes (10.5.1/10.5.25).

rubrics_metrics.name: 12 Furniture; sanitary installations (division 12)
rubrics_metrics.description: Furniture (12.1) including beds, cots, chairs, sofas, benches, tables, chests, cupboards, shelves, clothes stands; and sanitary installations (12.3) including baths, showers, washbasins, sinks, water closets, taps.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Notes include that office furniture is included in 12.1 and that cushions are in 9.1.23; auxiliary sections list specific furniture pieces (A 12.1.2–A 12.1.25) and taps/water closets (A 12.3.3–A 12.3.25).

rubrics_metrics.name: 12.1 Furniture (12.1.1)
rubrics_metrics.description: Furniture generally: cots, beds, cradles, chairs, armchairs, stools, benches, seats, sofas, tables, work benches, chests, trunks, cupboards, sideboards, safes, sets of shelves, clothes stands and other pieces of furniture.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Notes: cushions classified in 9.1.23; mirrors not included (10.5.17). Auxiliary labeled sections A 12.1.2–A 12.1.25 provide subtypes.

rubrics_metrics.name: 12.3 Sanitary installations (12.3.1)
rubrics_metrics.description: Sanitary installations and related fittings: baths, showers, washbasins, sinks, water closets, bidets, flushing cisterns, taps and other sanitary installations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Auxiliary sections list baths, showers, water closets and taps (A 12.3.3–A 12.3.11). Taps included whether part of an installation or not.

rubrics_metrics.name: 13 Lighting, wireless valves; heating, cooking or refrigerating equipment (division 13)
rubrics_metrics.description: Lighting apparatus, lamps, candles, flambeaux, lanterns, wireless valves, oil lamps and electric lamps (13.1) and heating/cooking/refrigerating equipment, washing machines/drying equipment and irons (13.3).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Principal sections include 13.1.1 (candles), 13.1.6 (lamps, wireless valves), and 13.3.1 (heating/cooking/refrigerating equipment). Auxiliary sections enumerate lamp parts, lamp types, electric bulbs, and household appliances (A 13.1.7–A 13.1.20; A 13.3.2–A 13.3.21).

rubrics_metrics.name: 13.1 Lighting, wireless valves (13.1.1, 13.1.6)
rubrics_metrics.description: Candles, candlesticks, torches, lamps, fairy lights, lanterns and wireless valves; includes electric torches, signalling flashlights, vehicle headlights, electric light bulbs/tubes and parts of lamps.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Auxiliary sections A 13.1.2–A 13.1.20 enumerate candlesticks, hurricane lamps, street lamps, table lamps, hanging lamps, bracket lamps, pocket lamps and parts; A 13.1.25 covers other lighting apparatus.

rubrics_metrics.name: 13.3 Heating, cooking or refrigerating equipment; washing/drying equipment (13.3.1)
rubrics_metrics.description: Boilers, stoves, radiators, kitchen stoves, plate warmers, grills, other cooking equipment, refrigerating equipment, washing machines, dishwashers, household drying equipment and irons.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Auxiliary sections specify hearths, braziers, parts of heating apparatus and refrigerating equipment (A 13.3.2–A 13.3.21).

rubrics_metrics.name: 14 Ironmongery, tools, ladders (division 14)
rubrics_metrics.description: Includes tubes/pipes, cables, heavy ironmongery (14.1), small ironmongery and springs (14.3), keys/locks/padlocks (14.5), tools (14.7), agricultural implements/ice axes (14.9), and ladders (14.11).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Notes indicate inclusion/exclusion boundaries (e.g., representations of non-metallic ironmongery included). Many auxiliary sections enumerate specific hardware parts and tools.

rubrics_metrics.name: 14.1 Tubes, cables, heavy ironmongery articles (14.1.1)
rubrics_metrics.description: Tubes, pipes, sluices; bars, cables (including electric cables), chains and other heavy ironmongery articles such as girders, rods, rails and structural frameworks.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Auxiliary sections include bent/coiled tubes, joints of pipes, braided cables, sections of cables, block chains, links, girder profiles, barbed wire, wire netting, and other heavy items (A 14.1.2–A 14.1.25). Cross-ref to 9.1.7 for electric cables note.

rubrics_metrics.name: 14.3 Small ironmongery articles, springs (14.3.1)
rubrics_metrics.description: Nails, screws, bolts, rivets, dowel pins, screw nuts, drawing pins, springs and other small ironmongery articles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes all springs; does not include door closers (15.1.25). Auxiliary sections categorize specific small items (A 14.3.2–A 14.3.21) and cross-reference 9.5.1 for some fasteners.

rubrics_metrics.name: 14.5 Keys for locks, locks, padlocks (14.5.1)
rubrics_metrics.description: Keys and parts of keys, locks, escutcheons, padlocks and related items.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Auxiliary sections list key counts, shapes, bows, flat keys, and other specific key types (A 14.5.2–A 14.5.19).

rubrics_metrics.name: 14.7 Tools (14.7.1, 14.7.2, 14.7.6, 14.7.18)
rubrics_metrics.description: Hand and power tools including hammers, sledge-hammers, mallets, axes, anvils, tongs, pincers, wrenches, screwdrivers, braces, drills, power drills, bits, sharpening stones, saws, blades, cutlery and scissors (division 14.7).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Handles included; excludes agricultural implements (14.9). Notes specify exclusions for certain blades (open razors 10.5.4, table knives 11.1.1, daggers 23.1.1). Auxiliary sections A 14.7.3–A 14.7.23 detail subtypes.

rubrics_metrics.name: 14.9 Agricultural or horticultural implements, ice axes (14.9.1)
rubrics_metrics.description: Spades, pickaxes, hoes, scythes, sickles and other agricultural/horticultural implements, with auxiliary listings for rakes, ploughs, ploughshares etc.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Auxiliary sections distinguish spade shapes, rakes and plough components (A 14.9.2–A 14.9.13).

rubrics_metrics.name: 14.11 Ladders (14.11.1)
rubrics_metrics.description: Ladders including single ladders, double ladders, stepladders and swimming pool ladders.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Auxiliary sections A 14.11.2–A 14.11.5 enumerate ladder subtypes.

rubrics_metrics.name: 15 Machinery, motors, engines; machines for household use; office machines; wheels, bearings; electrical equipment (division 15)
rubrics_metrics.description: Covers machines for industry/agriculture/industrial installations and motors/engines (15.1), household machines/spinning wheels (15.3), office machines (15.5), wheels and bearings (15.7) and electrical equipment (15.9).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Principal sections include 15.1.1, 15.3.1, 15.5.1, 15.7.1 and 15.9.1. Auxiliary sections enumerate conveyors, motors, propellers, parts (including robotic arms), cranes, petrol pumps, vending machines, washing machines, dishwashers, cog wheels, bearings, gears, electrical plugs, switches, integrated circuits and other apparatus (A 15.* entries).

rubrics_metrics.name: 15.1 Machines for industry or agriculture; industrial installations; motors, engines (15.1.1)
rubrics_metrics.description: Industrial machines (pressing, grinding, mixing, distilling, excavating), conveyor belts, motors, propellers, turbines, burners, machine parts (including robotic arms), cranes, pulleys, sprayers, agricultural machines, petrol pumps, automatic distributors and other mechanical appliances.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Notes clarify inclusions/exclusions (e.g., door closers included, power drills not included here but 14.7.6). Several auxiliary sections list specific machine types and parts.

rubrics_metrics.name: 15.3 Machines for household use; spinning wheels (15.3.1)
rubrics_metrics.description: Household machines (e.g., sewing machines, vacuum cleaners, polishers) and spinning wheels, distaffs, looms; excludes kitchen machines, washing machines and household drying equipment (classified elsewhere).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Auxiliary sections A 15.3.3–A 15.3.9 provide subtypes.

rubrics_metrics.name: 15.5 Office machines (15.5.1)
rubrics_metrics.description: Office machines such as typewriters (15.5.1) and other office machines (15.5.25).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Note excludes word processors (classified 16.1.4).

rubrics_metrics.name: 15.7 Wheels, bearings (15.7.1)
rubrics_metrics.description: Cog wheels, wheel cogs, ships' wheels, capstans, paddle wheels, ball bearings, gearing, transmission wheels, wheels with wings; excludes tyred vehicle wheels on axles (18.1.21).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Auxiliary sections categorize sawtoothed wheels, cog wheel segments, wheels/bearings with or without inscriptions/figurative elements (A 15.7.2–A 15.7.21).

rubrics_metrics.name: 15.9 Electrical equipment (15.9.1)
rubrics_metrics.description: Electrical equipment and accessories: batteries, sparking plugs, vehicle electrical accessories, electric plugs, switches, insulators, transistors, diodes, resistors, magnets, integrated circuits and computer chips.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Notes exclude electric lamps/wireless valves (13.1.6) and electric cables (14.1.5). Auxiliary sections A 15.9.2–A 15.9.25 enumerate parts and special items.

rubrics_metrics.name: 16 Telecommunications, sound recording or reproduction, computers; photography, cinematography, optics (division 16)
rubrics_metrics.description: Telecommunications and sound recording/reproduction apparatus, computers and related accessories (16.1) and photographic/cinematographic/optical apparatus and instruments (16.3).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Principal sections include radio/TV apparatus, computers/word processors, microphones, headphones, record players, discs, tapes (A 16.1.*) and photographic projection apparatus, lenses, cameras, spectacles, binoculars, telescopes and other optical instruments (16.3.1 and auxiliaries).

rubrics_metrics.name: 16.1 Telecommunication, television, sound recording or reproduction apparatus and computers (16.1.4)
rubrics_metrics.description: Radio/television apparatus, telecommunication equipment, computers, word processors, computer mice and keyboards, telephone receivers, fax machines, microphones, headphones, record players and recording media (discs, tapes).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Auxiliary sections A 16.1.5–A 16.1.25 list subtypes and note exclusions (e.g., wireless valves 13.1.6).

rubrics_metrics.name: 16.3 Photographic or cinematographic apparatus, optics (16.3.1)
rubrics_metrics.description: Photographic/cinematographic apparatus, projection apparatus, video cameras, photographic lenses, films, containers for films, spectacles, binoculars, microscopes, magnifying glasses, contact lenses and other optical apparatus or instruments.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Auxiliary sections include iris diaphragms and film containers (A 16.3.3, A 16.3.5); principal items 16.3.11–16.3.25 enumerate other optical apparatus.

rubrics_metrics.name: 17 Horological instruments, jewelry, weights and measures (division 17)
rubrics_metrics.description: Time-measuring instruments (17.1), jewelry and precious stones (17.2), balances and weights (17.3), and measures (17.5).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Principal sections include horological instruments (17.1.1), precious stones and pearls (17.2.1 & 17.2.5), balances/weights (17.3.1), and measures/calculating instruments (17.5.1) with auxiliary subdivisions enumerating dials, hands, watches, watch bracelets, necklaces, rings and measuring devices (A 17.*).

rubrics_metrics.name: 17.1 Horological and other time-measuring instruments (17.1.1)
rubrics_metrics.description: Clocks, watches, circular and non-circular dials, hands, sundials, sandglasses and other time-measuring instruments.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Auxiliary items include hands of instruments, parts, watches, clocks and watch bracelets (A 17.1.2–A 17.1.13). Notes exclude dials of measuring instruments other than horological (17.5.1).

rubrics_metrics.name: 17.2 Jewelry; precious stones and pearls (17.2.1, 17.2.5)
rubrics_metrics.description: Precious stones (cut and uncut), pearls, necklaces, bracelets, jewelry chains, rings, wedding rings, cuff links, tie/hardware pins and other jewels (division 17.2).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Auxiliary sections specify cut facets, representations and pearls in oysters (A 17.2.2–A 17.2.6).

rubrics_metrics.name: 17.3 Balances, weights (17.3.1)
rubrics_metrics.description: Balances and weights, including balances with two trays, other balances, parts and weights.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Auxiliary sections A 17.3.2–A 17.3.11 list specific balance types and parts.

rubrics_metrics.name: 17.5 Measures (17.5.1)
rubrics_metrics.description: Measures and calculating instruments including yardsticks, rulers, tape measures, slide rules, abacuses, gauges, calipers, micrometers, plumb lines, levels, compasses, squares and other measuring instruments.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Notes include that these cover calculating instruments but exclude time-measuring instruments (17.1) and balances/weights (17.3). Auxiliary sections A 17.5.2–A 17.5.25 enumerate specific measuring tools.

rubrics_metrics.name: 18 Transport; equipment for animals; vehicles for water/animal/air; traffic signs (division 18)
rubrics_metrics.description: Transport-related categories covering land vehicles (18.1), equipment for animals (18.2), vehicles for water (18.3), anchors/buoys (18.4), aerial/space vehicles (18.5) and traffic signs/indicator boards (18.7).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Principal sections include vehicles propelled by human/animal power (18.1.1), bicycles/motor cycles (18.1.5), motor road vehicles (18.1.7), motor boats and ships (18.3.14), aeroplanes/helicopters (18.5.1) and road/railway traffic signs (18.7.1). Numerous auxiliary sections detail subtypes, parts and stylized representations (A 18.*).

rubrics_metrics.name: 18.1 Land vehicles (18.1.1 et seq.)
rubrics_metrics.description: Vehicles propelled by human or animal power, bicycles, motorcycles, motor road vehicles, rail vehicles/trains, tyres, axles, steering wheels, radiators, exhausts, shock absorbers and other parts; also stylized land vehicles and other transport means such as cable cars and ski lifts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Auxiliary sections distinguish horse-drawn carriages, motor cars, lorries, coaches, tractors, locomotives, road rollers, lift trucks, caravans, perambulators, scooters and wheelchairs (A 18.1.2–A 18.1.20). Notes exclude escalators and conveyor belts (refer to other divisions).

rubrics_metrics.name: 18.2 Equipment for animals (18.2.1, 18.2.7, 18.2.17)
rubrics_metrics.description: Equipment for animals such as horseshoes, stirrups, spurs, harness, saddles, whips, collars and leashes for dogs and cats, and other equipment for animals.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Auxiliary sections A 18.2.9–A 18.2.18 list specific equipment; includes horseshoe-shaped magnets note.

rubrics_metrics.name: 18.3 Vehicles for use on water and amphibious vehicles (18.3.2, 18.3.14)
rubrics_metrics.description: Rowing boats, canoes, gondolas, sailing boats, sailboards, motor boats and ships, sails and other parts of boats; includes submarines, liners and other motor vessels.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Auxiliary sections A 18.3.3–A 18.3.18 list types such as Viking boats, ancient sailing boats, mixed sail/steam ships, liners, submarines, ship funnels; includes floating docks and amphibious vehicles in other means of transport.

rubrics_metrics.name: 18.4 Anchors; buoys or lifebelts (18.4.1)
rubrics_metrics.description: Anchors, buoys and lifebelts; includes crossed anchors and auxiliary listings for anchors and buoys/lifebelts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Auxiliary sections A 18.4.2–A 18.4.11 provide subtypes and stylized forms.

rubrics_metrics.name: 18.5 Aerial or space vehicles (18.5.1, 18.5.5, 18.5.10)
rubrics_metrics.description: Aeroplanes, helicopters, other aerial vehicles, balloons, kites, parachutes, delta-wing gliders and space rockets/capsules/artificial satellites.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Auxiliary sections include stylized aeroplanes (A 18.5.3), balloons and captive balloons, kites and parachutes (A 18.5.6–A 18.5.8).

rubrics_metrics.name: 18.7 Traffic signs and indicator boards (18.7.1)
rubrics_metrics.description: Road or railway traffic signs and indicator boards, direction indicator posts, street name/number plates, traffic lights, milestones and other road/rail signs; also water or air traffic signs (18.7.22).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Auxiliary sections A 18.7.9–A 18.7.25 list semaphores, signal buoys and other sign types.

rubrics_metrics.name: 19 Containers and packing; representations of miscellaneous products (division 19)
rubrics_metrics.description: Large and small containers, bottles, flasks, amphorae, pitchers, vases, flower pots, receptacles for laboratory/pharmacy use and medical/surgical apparatus; also parts or accessories of bottles and miscellaneous product representations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Principal sections include large containers (19.1), small containers (19.3), bottles/flasks (19.7), parts/accessories of bottles (19.8), amphorae/vases (19.9), receptacles for lab/pharmacy use (19.11) and medical/surgical apparatus (19.13). Auxiliary sections enumerate subtypes and specific exclusions (e.g., packaging, hermetically sealed tins).

rubrics_metrics.name: 19.1 Large containers (19.1.1, 19.1.3, 19.1.4)
rubrics_metrics.description: Large cylindrical/elliptical containers (tanks, gas bottles, barrels), large non-cylindrical containers (packing cases, crates), tins, cans, pails, watering cans and related containers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Auxiliary sections include vats, wooden buckets, barrel orientations, large sacks, baskets and other large containers (A 19.1.5–A 19.1.25). Notes exclude containers classified elsewhere (19.9).

rubrics_metrics.name: 19.3 Small containers (19.3.1, 19.3.3)
rubrics_metrics.description: Small cylindrical/elliptical containers (tubes for pills/lipsticks, cosmetic pots, preserve tins, jars, cans) and small non-cylindrical containers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Auxiliary sections list letter boxes, sachets, open small containers, tubes with wrappers, pinched tubes, paper/card for assembling small containers and other small containers (A 19.3.4–A 19.3.25). Notes exclude containers classified in 11.3, 19.7, 19.9 or 19.11.

rubrics_metrics.name: 19.7 Bottles, flasks (19.7.1–19.7.7)
rubrics_metrics.description: Bottles/flasks in circular or other cross-sections, bottles representing humans/animals/objects, bottles with handles, feeding bottles and other bottle shapes (division 19.7).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Auxiliary sections enumerate slender/squat/bottles without necks, with sloping/horizontal necks, inward-curving sides, bulging sides, conical shape, ribs, surface relief, wicker casings and other variants (A 19.7.9–A 19.7.24).

rubrics_metrics.name: 19.8 Parts or accessories of bottles (19.8.1)
rubrics_metrics.description: Parts or accessories of bottles including necks, stoppers, corks, sealing capsules, pouring devices and teats for babies' bottles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Notes exclude bottle openers and corkscrews (11.1.10). Auxiliary sections A 19.8.2–A 19.8.25 list specific parts and other accessories.

rubrics_metrics.name: 19.9 Amphorae, pitchers, vases, flower pots, flower stands (19.9.1)
rubrics_metrics.description: Amphorae, pitchers, decorative vases, flower pots, plant-growing pots and flower stands/plant boxes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Auxiliary sections A 19.9.2–A 19.9.9 enumerate amphora types, flower vases, pots and stands.
